items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Well, there was a Ma Rainey. Used to work with the Rabbit Foot show... I remember her singing over there.

ctx.x: Do you remember any famous singers? Like, for instance, I've heard that Ma Rainey was once with the Rabbit Foot. Whether it was the same one that you worked for, I don't know. I just wondered if you ever remember playing with any famous singers or hearing them with any of your shows.

Well, there was a Ma Rainey. Used to work with the Rabbit Foot show, but it wasn't the original Ma Rainey. It wasn't the original? No, it was a Ma Rainey that lives in Memphis, Tennessee. Oh, yeah. See, this one came from- See, Ma Rainey originally from-
